name: squatch-connect
description: Look up travel eSIM data plans, pricing, and coverage for Squatch Connect's catalog of destinations, and get a trip-based plan recommendation. Informational only — plans are purchased inside the Squatch Connect iOS app.

interface.longDescription: Squatch Connect helps you find and price travel eSIM data plans for destinations around the world, right inside ChatGPT. Ask what's covered, see exact per-destination pricing and data allowances, or get a recommendation for how much data a specific trip needs and which plan covers it. This plugin only looks things up in the Squatch Connect catalog — it does not sell anything, charge any payment method, or create an account, and it never links straight to a checkout. When you're ready, plans are purchased inside the separate Squatch Connect iOS app (Apple Pay or card), where the eSIM also installs with one tap. Squatch Connect itself requires no account and collects no personal data to use.
defaultPrompt: What eSIM plans does Squatch Connect have for Japan?
I'm going to Italy for 10 days and will stream a lot — what plan should I get?
List Squatch Connect's eSIM destinations in Europe.

positive.description: User asks what's covered in a region; should list destinations, not prices.
positive.prompt: What eSIM destinations does Squatch Connect cover in Europe?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_destinations (kind='region' and/or query='europe'), and returns the Europe region entry and/or individual European countries with flag, id, and kind. Does not fabricate pricing and suggests get_plans as the next step for prices.

positive.description: User asks for pricing on a specific, well-known destination.
positive.prompt: What eSIM plans does Squatch Connect have for Japan, and how much do they cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_plans with destination='Japan' and returns the real plan list (data allowance, validity in days, USD price, network) straight from the catalog, with no invented plans or links to buy.

positive.description: User wants a recommendation sized to a real trip, a case a single plan comfortably covers.
positive.prompt: I'm going to Italy for 10 days and mostly using maps and social media — what plan should I get?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls recommend_plan with destination='Italy', trip_days=10, usage='moderate', and returns the cheapest plan that covers the trip's estimated data and full length, with a one- or two-sentence rationale.

positive.description: User's trip is longer than any single plan's validity — the plugin must say so honestly rather than overselling one plan.
positive.prompt: I'll be in Thailand for 45 days using a lot of data for video calls — what plan covers that?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls recommend_plan with destination='Thailand', trip_days=45, usage='heavy'. Since no single plan is likely to cover 45 days, the response states that plainly and suggests combining more than one plan, instead of silently recommending an insufficient plan as if it were a full match.

positive.description: User asks how to actually get the app and whether their phone qualifies, which is app/device info, not pricing.
positive.prompt: How do I get Squatch Connect, and will it work on my iPhone?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_app_info and returns the App Store listing URL, the device requirement (eSIM-capable, carrier-unlocked iPhone XS/XR or newer on iOS 17+), and a note that plans are purchased inside the app itself — described informationally, with no 'buy now' link or in-chat checkout offered.

negative.description: Booking travel is out of scope — Squatch Connect only sells eSIM data plans, not flights, hotels, or itineraries.
negative.prompt: Can you book me a flight to Tokyo for next week?

negative.description: The plugin must never attempt to charge a card or complete a purchase in chat; every plan is bought inside the iOS app, never here.
negative.prompt: Just charge my card on file $15 and send me the Japan eSIM right now.

negative.description: Squatch Connect's catalog is travel eSIMs only — it has no data on a user's home-country carrier plan or contract.
negative.prompt: What's the best phone plan for my home carrier contract renewal in the US?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It looks up public eSIM plans and prices; plans are bought inside the Squatch Connect iOS app.
